facts.statement: The controller shall start the automatic fill-transfer-drain sequence upon a valid START command when the process is idle or paused.
facts.quote: C4=The controller shall start the automatic fill-transfer-drain sequence upon a valid START command when the process is idle or paused.

facts.statement: The automatic sequence shall open inlet valve V1 to fill Tank 1.
facts.quote: C5=The automatic sequence shall open inlet valve V1 to fill Tank 1.

facts.statement: When Tank 1 reaches its high-level limit, V1 shall close.
facts.quote: C6=When Tank 1 reaches its high-level limit, V1 shall close.

facts.statement: After Tank 1 reaches the high-level limit, the controller shall wait 10 s before opening V2.
facts.quote: C7=After Tank 1 reaches the high-level limit, the controller shall wait 10 s before opening V2.

facts.statement: V2 shall transfer liquid from Tank 1 to Tank 2 until Tank 1 reaches its low-level limit.
facts.quote: C8=V2 shall transfer liquid from Tank 1 to Tank 2 until Tank 1 reaches its low-level limit.

facts.statement: After Tank 1 reaches the low-level limit, the controller shall wait 10 s before opening V3.
facts.quote: C9=After Tank 1 reaches the low-level limit, the controller shall wait 10 s before opening V3.

facts.statement: V3 shall drain Tank 2 until Tank 2 reaches its low-level limit.
facts.quote: C10=V3 shall drain Tank 2 until Tank 2 reaches its low-level limit.

facts.statement: After Tank 2 reaches its low-level limit, the controller shall return to the Tank 1 filling operation after 10 s.
facts.quote: C11=After Tank 2 reaches its low-level limit, the controller shall return to the Tank 1 filling operation after 10 s.

facts.statement: STOP shall close V1, V2 and V3 and place the controller in a paused condition.
facts.quote: C12=STOP shall close V1, V2 and V3 and place the controller in a paused condition.

facts.statement: A START command following STOP shall continue the sequence from the point at which STOP was accepted.
facts.quote: C13=A START command following STOP shall continue the sequence from the point at which STOP was accepted.

facts.statement: SHUT shall command V2 and V3 open to drain both tanks and shall inhibit V1.
facts.quote: C14=SHUT shall command V2 and V3 open to drain both tanks and shall inhibit V1.

facts.statement: After shutdown draining is complete, all three valves shall be closed and the controller shall be in the initial idle configuration.
facts.quote: C15=After shutdown draining is complete, all three valves shall be closed and the controller shall be in the initial idle configuration.

facts.statement: On loss of controller power, all process valves shall move to or remain in the closed position.
facts.quote: C16=On loss of controller power, all process valves shall move to or remain in the closed position.

facts.statement: SHUT shall have higher command priority than STOP; STOP shall have higher priority than START.
facts.quote: C17=SHUT shall have higher command priority than STOP; STOP shall have higher priority than START.

facts.statement: V1 shall never be commanded open while V2 is open.
facts.quote: C18=V1 shall never be commanded open while V2 is open.

facts.statement: During normal automatic operation, V2 and V3 shall not be open simultaneously.
facts.quote: C19=During normal automatic operation, V2 and V3 shall not be open simultaneously.

facts.statement: During SHUT mode, V2 and V3 may be open simultaneously.
facts.quote: C20=During SHUT mode, V2 and V3 may be open simultaneously.

facts.statement: Tank 1 high-level setpoint shall be 0.78 m.
facts.quote: C21=Tank 1 high-level setpoint shall be 0.78 m.

facts.statement: Tank 1 high-level setpoint shall be 0.80 m.
facts.quote: C22=Tank 1 high-level setpoint shall be 0.80 m.

facts.statement: Tank 1 low-level setpoint shall be 0.05 m.
facts.quote: C23=Tank 1 low-level setpoint shall be 0.05 m.

facts.statement: Tank 2 low-level setpoint shall be 0.05 m.
facts.quote: C24=Tank 2 low-level setpoint shall be 0.05 m.

facts.statement: The post-transfer waiting time shall be 12 s.
facts.quote: C25=The post-transfer waiting time shall be 12 s.

facts.statement: The inter-cycle waiting time after Tank 2 reaches low level shall be 8 s.
facts.quote: C26=The inter-cycle waiting time after Tank 2 reaches low level shall be 8 s.

facts.statement: The controller shall receive two analog level measurements designated LT-101 and LT-102.
facts.quote: C27=The controller shall receive two analog level measurements designated LT-101 and LT-102.

facts.statement: The controller shall receive momentary START, STOP and SHUT digital commands.
facts.quote: C28=The controller shall receive momentary START, STOP and SHUT digital commands.

facts.statement: The controller shall provide three discrete valve-open commands to XV-101, XV-102 and XV-103.
facts.quote: C29=The controller shall provide three discrete valve-open commands to XV-101, XV-102 and XV-103.

facts.statement: A STOP command received during a wait state shall freeze the wait timer rather than restart it.
facts.quote: C30=A STOP command received during a wait state shall freeze the wait timer rather than restart it.

facts.statement: START commands received while already running shall be ignored.
facts.quote: C31=START commands received while already running shall be ignored.

facts.statement: STOP commands received during SHUT mode shall be ignored until shutdown is complete.
facts.quote: C32=STOP commands received during SHUT mode shall be ignored until shutdown is complete.

facts.statement: START commands received during SHUT mode shall be ignored until shutdown is complete.
facts.quote: C33=START commands received during SHUT mode shall be ignored until shutdown is complete.

facts.statement: Shutdown completion shall require Tank 1 and Tank 2 to both be at or below their low-level setpoints.
facts.quote: C34=Shutdown completion shall require Tank 1 and Tank 2 to both be at or below their low-level setpoints.

facts.statement: The demonstration run shall simulate from 0 s through 900 s.
facts.quote: C35=The demonstration run shall simulate from 0 s through 900 s.

facts.statement: The demonstration run shall apply START at 20 s, STOP at 220 s, START at 280 s, STOP at 650 s and SHUT at 700 s.
facts.quote: C36=The demonstration run shall apply START at 20 s, STOP at 220 s, START at 280 s, STOP at 650 s and SHUT at 700 s.

facts.statement: Level values shall be represented internally in metres with a nominal valid range of 0.0 to 1.0 m.
facts.quote: C37=Level values shall be represented internally in metres with a nominal valid range of 0.0 to 1.0 m.

facts.statement: Valve commands shall be represented as Boolean open/closed commands.
facts.quote: C38=Valve commands shall be represented as Boolean open/closed commands.
